subject.title: fix(ai): honor Responses reasoning effort maps

question: Should OpenAI Responses gain a separate `compat` API for reasoning effort maps, or should provider-native values remain exclusively owned by model-level `thinkingLevelMap`?
rationale: This is a public configuration and model-contract choice, not only a mechanical transport repair: the two fields overlap and the branch establishes precedence between them.

options.title: Keep one canonical map
options.body: Use `thinkingLevelMap` for Responses as well, and extend resolver support so its provider-native values can be validated and emitted without a second compatibility setting.

options.title: Adopt a Responses-specific compat API
options.body: Accept the new compatibility fields only with an explicit precedence, configuration documentation, and upgrade contract for providers that already use `thinkingLevelMap`.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical map
recommendation.body: Use `thinkingLevelMap` for Responses as well, and extend resolver support so its provider-native values can be validated and emitted without a second compatibility setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assignment and the public configuration-contract choice make this the most likely available routing owner.
